game_title: Truth Table Tiles – Sunken Wreck Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Coastal Port – Sunken Wreck, a wreck beneath the waves: the harbor master must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Truth Table Tiles: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path.
theme: Coastal Port – Sunken Wreck: a wreck beneath the waves
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Wreck, repeat each round: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the table_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sea wall using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The sea wall reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the sea wall is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Truth Table Tiles
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Truth Table Tiles' (Week 3 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sunken Wreck'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how table_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Sunken Wreck.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sea wall reached with actions_used <= 16.
